LESSON: READING 15.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.2: Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can one display emotions or feelings when reading a text? 2. Why should we read a text at the right speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship is fostered as learners explore texts on tourist attraction in Africa and this in turn enhances their global awareness.

Values:
Peace is promoted as learners work together in groups to recite the choral verses.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCI)

Effective Communication is sharpened as learners perfect their reading skills.

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: How can one display emotions or feelings when reading a text? 2. Why should we read a text at the right speed?
